notes:
v4.6.30 — Overview 2-wide bot grid + custom bots show data in their tab

💄 LAYOUT
• Overview bot blocks now stack 2 per row instead of 3. Each block has 4-6 metric cards that were too cramped at 3-wide to read; 2-wide gives them room and stacks extra bots underneath.

🐛 FIXED — custom bots showed no data/graphs under the console
• core.data trade-log + snapshot lookups were hardcoded to LONG/SHORT/DAY. Custom bots (crypto, bollinger, etc.) resolved to nothing, so their Closed Trades feed + equity history were always empty. New log_files_for(side) / snapshot_files_for(side) helpers resolve <slug>_trade_log.jsonl and <slug>_lifetime.jsonl for any side.
• BotRunner now writes a <side>_trade_log.jsonl entry on every executed order (BUY/SELL/SHORT/COVER) in the same shape built-ins use, keyed by APEX_BOT_SIDE so it matches what the tab reads. The crypto bot template does the same.
• Result: a custom bot's tab now populates the Closed Trades feed + equity chart once it has traded, just like the built-ins.

Includes v4.6.29 broker selector + v4.6.28 bot-lifetime metrics + universe_manager auth fix.
